_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

app.description: Application context of the document: Auto = automotive caliper MES, Gamp = pharmaceutical GMP, Common = reference data shared by both

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

name.description: Name of the product variant; used as its display value in other collections

baseItemName.description: Display value of baseItemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

variantItemName.description: Display value of variantItemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

customerName.description: Display value of customerId, copied from u_mes_mast_customer.name

optionsPadCompoundId.description: Reference to u_mes_prod_padCompound._id: options pad compound

optionsPadCompoundName.description: Display value of optionsPadCompoundId, copied from u_mes_prod_padCompound.name

optionsMarketName.description: Display value of optionsMarketId, copied from u_mes_prod_market.name

optionsSurfaceFinishId.description: Reference to u_mes_prod_surfaceFinish._id: options surface finish

optionsSurfaceFinishName.description: Display value of optionsSurfaceFinishId, copied from u_mes_prod_surfaceFinish.name

vehicleModelName.description: Display value of vehicleModelId, copied from u_mes_prod_vehicleModel.name

effectiveFrom.description: Effective from. Date field: calendar date only, stored as 00:00:00 of that day in local plant time (IST) with the +0000 suffix

effectiveTo.description: Effective to. Date field: calendar date only, stored as 00:00:00 of that day in local plant time (IST) with the +0000 suffix

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
